title: Loading a saved packed TileMapLayer with scenes duplicates the scenes
body:
### Tested versions

reproducible in v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

windows 11 Home 23H2

### Issue description

When saving a TileMapLayer as a packed scene and reloading it any scene that were present on the tilemap layer are duplicated. One set comes of scenes is the ones who's owner is changed (to be saved) and another from the tilemap layer itself - it saves the original properties of the scenes and when loaded instantiates new ones.

While I see this being a feature - you want to somehow save the original state of the TileMapLayer, to me it comes across as a bug as the scenes from the TileMapLayer are instantiated again when loading a saved TileMapLayer producing twice the amount of scenes. Perhaps there should be a flag on the TileMapLayer to indicate whether you want to save original scene state.

### Steps to reproduce

Can open the attached project or create a brand new one with steps below:
- create a tile map layer and tile set
- create a tile scene with a 2d sprite
- add the tile scene to the tileset
- place the tile scene on the tile map layer
- add a script which changes the owner of the tile map layer and its children to the root (such that all is saved)
- add two buttons, one to save scene, one to delete and load scene
```
func set_owner_recursive(node:Node, new_owner: Node):
	for child in node.get_children():
		child.owner = new_owner
		set_owner_recursive(child, new_owner)

func _on_save_button_pressed() -> void:
	set_owner_recursive(test_scene, test_scene)

	var scene = PackedScene.new()
	scene.pack(test_scene)
	ResourceSaver.save(scene, test_save_path)

func _on_load_button_pressed() -> void:
	remove_child(test_scene)
	test_scene.queue_free()

	var new_node = load(test_save_path).instantiate()
	add_child(new_node)
```
- run, press save, then press load
- observe in 'remote' that the tile scene has been duplicated

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[testtilemapduplication - Copy.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17452320/testtilemapduplication.-.Copy.zip)
